# repos tools

Repository management - activate user workspaces, manage golden repositories, and control indexing

27 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `activate_repository`

Create user workspace for editing files, non-default branches, or composites.

- Permission: `activate_repos`
- Source: [repos/activate_repository.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/repos/activate_repository.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `golden_repo_alias` | string | no | Golden repository alias without the -global suffix, for a single-repository workspace. |
| `golden_repo_aliases` | array of string | no | Two or more golden repository aliases for a composite workspace. |
| `branch_name` | string | no | Branch to activate (optional; defaults to the golden repository's default branch) |
| `user_alias` | string | no | Alias for the new workspace (optional; defaults to the golden repository alias) |

## `add_golden_repo`

[ADMIN ONLY] Register a new repository for indexing (ASYNC operation). Requires MCP elevation when enforcement is on.

- Permission: `manage_golden_repos`
- Source: [repos/add_golden_repo.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/repos/add_golden_repo.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `url` | string | yes | Repository URL |
| `alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `branch` | string | no | Default branch (optional) |
| `enable_temporal` | boolean | no | Enable temporal indexing (git history search). |
| `temporal_options` | object | no | Temporal indexing configuration options. |

## `add_golden_repo_index`

[ADMIN ONLY] Add an index type to an existing golden repository. Requires MCP elevation when enforcement is on.

- Permission: `manage_golden_repos`
- Source: [repos/add_golden_repo_index.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/repos/add_golden_repo_index.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `alias` | string | yes | Golden repository alias (base name, not '-global' suffix) |
| `index_type` | string (one of: `semantic`, `fts`, `temporal`, `scip`) | yes | Index type to add: 'semantic' for embedding-based search, 'fts' for full-text search, 'temporal' for git history search, 'scip' for call graph navigation |

## `bulk_add_provider_index`

[ADMIN ONLY] Add a provider's semantic index to every global repository that lacks it.

| `provider` | string | yes | Embedding provider name to add indexes for. |
| `filter` | string | no | Optional filter. |

## `trigger_reindex`

Trigger manual re-indexing for specified index types.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [repos/trigger_reindex.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/repos/trigger_reindex.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Alias of one of your activated repositories (not a -global alias) |
| `index_types` | array of string (one of: `semantic`, `fts`, `temporal`, `scip`) | yes | Array of index types to rebuild: semantic (embeddings), fts (full-text), scip (call graphs). temporal is listed but rejected for activated repositories. |
| `clear` | boolean | no | Rebuild from scratch (true) or incremental update (false). |
